data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate released GBP 8.7 million of technical reserves in 2015, representing a 24.72% reduction of its opening gross claims outstanding. This favorable development was predominantly related to fire and other damage to property risks from prior periods. The report also noted several specific losses from the 2013 underwriting year, including a GBP 1.7 million claim from a medical isotope plant in South Africa and a GBP 1.5 million claim from a fuel fabrication plant in the UK. A GBP 1.4 million reserve for a possible material damage loss in China from 2013 was also withdrawn. In 2015, the syndicate experienced two losses in non-power areas, one from a fire in France and another from dust contamination in a fuel plant in the Netherlands, with a total reserve of GBP 2.4 million for these two claims.
